_note: Training methods and level brackets are stable; XP/hr figures are approximate and vary with gear, location and effort. Every entry links the OSRS Wiki for full detail.

Attack.blurb: Melee accuracy — shared XP with your weapon of choice.

methods.name: Waterfall Quest
methods.note: ~13k Attack & Strength on completion — skip the early grind.

methods.name: Sand / Ammonite Crabs
methods.note: Very AFK. Best weapon, aggression potions, cannon optional.

methods.name: Nightmare Zone
methods.note: AFK with absorptions + Guthan's; earns points for imbues.

methods.name: Slayer
methods.note: Slower XP but pays for itself in drops — the ironman route.

Attack.fastest: Nightmare Zone or aggressive Slayer with your best weapon; combat XP is shared, so train Attack/Strength/Defence on the same monsters.

Strength.blurb: Melee damage — the single biggest DPS stat for melee.

methods.name: Waterfall Quest
methods.note: ~13k Attack & Strength instantly.

methods.name: Sand / Ammonite Crabs
methods.note: AFK; controlled or aggressive style.

methods.name: Nightmare Zone (Dharok/aggression)
methods.note: One of the fastest AFK melee methods.

methods.name: Slayer / bossing
methods.note: XP plus valuable drops.

unlocks: Higher Strength = higher max hit with every melee weapon
Enables Dragon Slayer II & other quest gear
Strength.fastest: Nightmare Zone on aggressive/controlled with your best crush or slash weapon.

Defence.blurb: Damage reduction and gear unlocks — but watch it on pures/mains.

methods.name: Quests + Crabs
methods.note: Fresh Start / Waterfall then crabs on defensive.

methods.name: Nightmare Zone / Slayer (defensive)
methods.note: Long-range train on defensive style.

Defence.fastest: Train Defence on the controlled/defensive style while doing your normal combat XP.

Hitpoints.blurb: Rises passively as you train the other combat styles — no separate grind.

methods.name: Any combat training
methods.note: Every melee/ranged hit and Magic combat spell gives Hitpoints XP.

methods.name: NMZ / Slayer / bossing
methods.note: Focus your combat method; HP follows automatically.

unlocks: Higher HP = larger health pool for every activity
Hitpoints.fastest: There's no dedicated HP grind — it comes free with Attack/Strength/Ranged/Magic training.

Ranged.blurb: The most versatile combat style — and home to the fastest combat XP in the game.

methods.name: Sand Crabs / cannon on Slayer
methods.note: Best bow you can wield; AFK on crabs.

methods.name: Chinning (Maniacal monkeys)
methods.note: Fastest Ranged XP; needs Monkey Madness II and a supply of chinchompas.

methods.name: Nightmare Zone / Slayer
methods.note: Cheaper, AFK, with drops.

Ranged.fastest: Chinning maniacal monkeys is the fastest combat XP in the game — expensive, but unmatched.

Prayer.blurb: Expensive but transformative — offer bones at an altar for fast XP.

methods.name: Gilded altar (POH) + dragon/superior bones
methods.note: Standard fast method; two burners lit for +350% XP.

methods.name: Chaos Altar (Wilderness)
methods.note: ~50% chance to not consume the bone — cheapest, but PK risk. Ironman favourite.

methods.name: Ensouled heads (Arceuus)
methods.note: Combines Prayer with Magic XP.

Prayer.fastest: Superior dragon bones on a gilded altar — or the Chaos Altar to halve the bone cost.

Magic.blurb: Utility spells, powered staves, and some of the fastest AoE XP once you have Ancients.

methods.name: Quests + strike/bolt spells or splashing
methods.note: Splash to 33 for stun-alch; or curse spells for gp.

methods.name: High Alchemy
methods.note: Semi-AFK and often profitable while you do other things.

methods.name: Bursting / Barraging on Slayer (Ancients)
methods.note: Fastest Magic XP; needs Desert Treasure I + a good multi task.

methods.name: Trident / powered staves on Slayer
methods.note: Solid XP plus drops.

unlocks: Ancient Magicks (Desert Treasure I) — ice/blood barrage
Magic.fastest: Ice/blood barraging a multi-Slayer task (dust devils, nechryael) is the fastest — plus valuable drops.

Runecraft.blurb: Historically slow, but blood/soul runes and Guardians of the Rift changed the game.

methods.name: Lava runes (binding necklace / Abyss)
methods.note: Profitable, decent XP once you unlock the shortcuts.

methods.name: Guardians of the Rift
methods.note: Well-rounded XP + rewards (Rift Guardian pet, catalytic runes, outfit).

methods.name: Blood / Soul runes (Arceuus)
methods.note: AFK-ish and very profitable — the best late-game XP.

Runecraft.fastest: Guardians of the Rift for balanced XP and rewards, or blood/soul runes for AFK profit.

Construction.blurb: The classic 'buyable' — fast XP if funded, cheaper minigame routes otherwise.

methods.name: Crude/oak chairs → oak larders
methods.note: Cheap start; a butler saves runs.

methods.name: Mahogany tables
methods.note: Fastest method if you can fund the planks — needs a demon butler.

methods.name: Mahogany Homes (contracts)
methods.note: Much cheaper, gives planks/supplies — the ironman route.

Construction.fastest: Oak larders early, then mahogany tables with a demon butler if you can afford it.

Agility.blurb: Slow but unlocks run energy, shortcuts, and Marks of Grace for the Graceful outfit.

methods.name: Rooftop courses
methods.note: Draynor 10 → Varrock 30 → Canifis 40 → Seers 60 → Pollnivneach 70 → Rellekka 80 → Ardougne 90. Marks of Grace drop for Graceful.

methods.name: Hallowed Sepulchre
methods.note: Best XP + loot (hallowed marks, coins, dark graceful); scales at 62/72/82/92.

methods.name: Brimhaven Agility Arena
methods.note: Tickets for Graceful and the Agile outfit.

Agility.fastest: Rooftops until you can enter the Hallowed Sepulchre (52), then Sepulchre floors as high as you can reach.

Herblore.blurb: Makes your combat potions — expensive to buy, cheap if you farm the ingredients.

methods.name: Make potions up the ladder
methods.note: Attack/Strength pots → prayer pots → super potions → super combats → divines.

methods.name: Super combat / divine potions
methods.note: Fast if funded; each potion is one click.

methods.name: Farm herbs + secondaries
methods.note: Herb runs + your own secondaries keep you stocked without the GE.

unlocks: Prayer potions, super combats, stamina, divine potions, antifire, sanfew
Herblore.fastest: Whatever potion is most XP-per-gp you can afford — super combats late; ironmen farm the inputs.

Thieving.blurb: Great gp and fast XP once you reach Ardougne Knights or blackjacking.

methods.name: Men / stalls / cake & fruit stalls
methods.note: Cheap early XP and a little gp.

methods.name: Ardougne Knights (pickpocket)
methods.note: Big gp; Ardougne Diary doubles loot. Dodgy necklace + shadow gear help.

methods.name: Blackjacking (Pollnivneach)
methods.note: Highest XP, click-intensive.

methods.name: Pyramid Plunder
methods.note: XP + artefacts; scales with level.

Thieving.fastest: Blackjacking for pure XP, or Ardougne Knights for XP plus serious gp.

Farming.blurb: Trained in short daily 'runs', not grinded — one of the best skills to level passively.

methods.name: Tree & fruit-tree runs
methods.note: A few minutes a day; enormous XP per sapling as you level.

methods.name: Herb runs
methods.note: Pairs perfectly with Herblore self-sufficiency.

methods.name: Hardwood trees / Hespori / Farming Guild
methods.note: Fossil Island hardwoods and the Farming Guild add big daily XP.

Farming.fastest: Do the full tree + fruit-tree + herb run circuit every day — the XP compounds fast.

Fishing.blurb: AFK-friendly with money-makers along the way; barbarian fishing trains three skills at once.

methods.name: Shrimp → fly fishing trout/salmon
methods.note: Fly fishing at Barbarian Village or Shilo.

methods.name: Barbarian fishing
methods.note: Also gives Agility & Strength XP; 3-tick pushes ~90k/hr.

methods.name: Anglerfish / Minnows / Sacred eels
methods.note: Anglerfish for food; minnows for gp (needs Fishing Guild).

Fishing.fastest: Barbarian fishing (with 3-tick for max rates), or minnows for money.

Crafting.blurb: Gems, glass, leather and jewellery — plenty of routes, some profitable.

methods.name: Cut gems / make leather & d'hide
methods.note: Sapphires→diamonds; then green→black d'hide bodies.

methods.name: Glassblowing / superglass make
methods.note: Lunar 'Superglass Make' (Lunar Diplomacy) speeds it up massively.

methods.name: Battlestaves
methods.note: Air/water/etc. battlestaves — steady XP, decent value.

unlocks: Crafting your own jewellery (games necklace, rings of dueling)
Crafting.fastest: Superglass Make (Lunar) for speed; d'hide bodies or battlestaves for a cheaper climb.

Firemaking.blurb: Slow with logs, excellent with Wintertodt — the go-to from level 50.

methods.name: Burn logs (up the ladder)
methods.note: Regular→oak→willow→maple as you level toward 50.

methods.name: Wintertodt
methods.note: The standard method — Firemaking XP plus supplies, pets and rewards.

methods.name: 2-tick Wintertodt / burn redwoods
methods.note: Tick manipulation pushes the top rates.

unlocks: Wintertodt loot (herbs, seeds, ores, Warm gloves, Pyromancer outfit, Phoenix pet)
Firemaking.fastest: Wintertodt from 50 to 99 — great XP and it pays for itself in supplies.

Cooking.blurb: One of the fastest skills in the game — wines will carry you to 99.

methods.name: Cook fish / make basics
methods.note: Trout, salmon, then up the fish ladder.

methods.name: Jugs of wine
methods.note: Fastest method; cheap ingredients, near-instant per batch.

methods.name: Karambwans / wines
methods.note: Karambwans near-profit; wines for pure speed.

unlocks: Cooking gauntlets (RFD) — fewer burns on sharks/karambwans
Cooking.fastest: Jugs of wine from ~35 all the way to 99.

Fletching.blurb: Buyable and semi-AFK — dart-making is basically instant XP if you can fund it.

methods.name: Cut then string bows
methods.note: Shortbows/longbows up the wood ladder; profit on some.

methods.name: Adamant/rune darts
methods.note: Near-instant clicks; the fastest XP if funded — needs the smithing/quest unlock.

methods.name: Broad arrows / bolts
methods.note: Cheaper alternative to darts.

unlocks: Make your own arrows/bolts/darts as ammo
Fletching.fastest: Rune darts if you can afford them; otherwise stringing bows for near-break-even XP.

Woodcutting.blurb: The definitive AFK skill — or push tick-manipulation for surprisingly fast XP.

methods.name: Regular → oaks → willows
methods.note: Willows/teaks are the classic climb.

methods.name: Teak trees (1.5t/2t)
methods.note: Tick-manipulated teaks are the fastest WC XP.

methods.name: Redwoods
methods.note: Very AFK and profitable.

methods.name: Sulliuscep (Fossil Island)
methods.note: XP + Numulite; needs Bone Voyage.

Woodcutting.fastest: Tick-manipulated teak trees for speed, or redwoods for an AFK profit.

Mining.blurb: AFK at Motherlode Mine or push 3-tick granite / Volcanic Mine for fast XP.

methods.name: Copper / tin
methods.note: Or mine iron from 15.

methods.name: Iron power-mining
methods.note: Drop the ore; fast but click-heavy.

methods.name: Motherlode Mine
methods.note: Nuggets buy the Prospector kit (+XP); very AFK.

methods.name: Volcanic Mine / 3t granite / amethyst
methods.note: Volcanic Mine is the fastest; amethyst (92) is AFK profit.

Mining.fastest: Volcanic Mine or 3-tick granite for speed; Motherlode Mine to AFK.

Smithing.blurb: Blast Furnace for smelting speed, or Giants' Foundry for a rewarding minigame route.

methods.name: Blast Furnace (gold bars + gauntlets)
methods.note: Goldsmith gauntlets (from Family Crest) make gold bars the fastest XP.

methods.name: Giants' Foundry
methods.note: Minigame XP + Smiths' outfit and Kovac's rewards.

methods.name: Cannonballs / smith gear
methods.note: Cannonballs for your own cannon ammo.

unlocks: Smith your own gear and cannonballs
Smithing.fastest: Blast Furnace gold bars with goldsmith gauntlets, or Giants' Foundry for XP + rewards.

Slayer.blurb: The skill that funds the account — tasks unlock best-in-slot gear and drop huge loot.

methods.name: Assigned tasks up the master ladder
methods.note: Turael → Mazchna → Vannaka → Chaeldar → Nieve/Steve → Duradel/Konar.

methods.name: Turael/Spria skips
methods.note: Skip bad tasks and build streaks for points.

methods.name: Duradel / Konar + cannon or barrage
methods.note: Cannon or ice-barrage big tasks for speed; Konar for brimstone/unique drops.

unlocks: Rings/whips/trident/occult and dozens of gear unlocks by level
Slayer.fastest: Block/skip low-XP tasks and barrage or cannon the big ones; take points-heavy Slayer seriously — it's your gp engine.

Hunter.blurb: Birdhouses tick along passively; chinning and maniacal monkeys give the fast XP.

methods.name: Birdhouse runs (Fossil Island)
methods.note: A couple of minutes every ~50 min; superb for ironmen.

methods.name: Chinchompas (grey/red/black)
methods.note: Box traps; also stockpiles chins for Ranged.

methods.name: Maniacal monkeys (MM2)
methods.note: The fastest Hunter XP; needs Monkey Madness II.

methods.name: Herbiboar (Fossil Island)
methods.note: No traps; great for ironmen.

Hunter.fastest: Maniacal monkeys for pure XP; birdhouses + herbiboar for passive, ironman-friendly gains.
